title: Eval definition metadata
description: Structural metadata for one agent-behavior eval. The task, expected findings, rubric, and fixture repository live in sibling files.

name.description: Eval identifier; must match the fixture directory name.

description.description: What agent behavior this eval exercises.

task_file.description: Task prompt given to the agent, relative to the fixture dir.

expected_file.description: Semantic ground truth, relative to the fixture dir.

rubric_file.description: Grading criteria, relative to the fixture dir.
